title: RailsConf 2019 - Opening Keynote by David Heinemeier Hansson
summary: David Heinemeier Hansson's opening keynote at RailsConf 2019 argues against the expectation of payment for open source work, drawing on his experience releasing Rails. It also includes lighter asides about the industry.
why: It is the go-to reference in debates about whether open source maintainers are owed compensation, and commenters say it is worth watching even for non-Rails developers.

quote.text: Even if you're not a Rails developer it's worth watching.
